verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server (docs.stripe.com/mcp), and Treasury is exposed via the standard Stripe API that this MCP server is built to interface with, so the axis applies and is nominally satisfied. However, the evidence pack gives no Treasury-specific detail on what MCP tools/actions are exposed, no independent/hands-on confirmation of agent connectivity, and no documentation scoping money-movement or financial-account operations to the MCP interface. Missing for 10: Treasury-specific MCP tool documentation, hands-on/independent verification of agent use, and confirmation that sensitive money-movement operations are safely exposed via MCP.
